conclusion: Coverage is limited by the query window, not by missing history: the SQL restricts block_timestamp to the 90 days before the query date, every observed timestamp of the 126 covered wallets lies in 2026-01-22..2026-04-20 (span 89 days), and none overlaps the 2015-2019 MulDiGraph period. The full-history public table was never queried for 2015-2019, so this is a design limitation of the enrichment step.
